meta.description: Magical Land gates & keys, monster HP and rewards, and red-flag potion requirements for Zones 4 and 5.

site.title: Magical Land Guide
site.lead: Gates & keys, monster HP and rewards, and red-flag potion requirements — all on one page.

gates.title: Gates & Keys
gates.intro: Open each island's gate with Bronze (rusty) Keys or Gold Keys to claim these rewards.
gates.totalNote: Opening every gate takes {bronze} bronze keys and {gold} gold keys in total.

monsters.title: Monsters
monsters.intro: 14-monster edition (Bunny Coin version) — 13 monsters, Zone 1 excluded. Each monster has three HP stages, each with its own reward.
monsters.summary: Showing {count} monsters · Suggested potions in total:
monsters.potionNote: Suggested potions = total potions needed to clear the monster, roughly HP × 2.

potions.intro: Standard version. Switch by bet; each cell is the potions needed for that step, moving 🚩0/3 → 🚩1/3 → 🚩2/3 in order.
potions.cyclopsNote: Red cells are the Cyclops (tested at 10× straight run).

footer.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made info compiled by the player community; not affiliated with the game's publisher. Values may change with updates.
